name: Fareclock
description_en:
Fareclock is an attendance and workforce-management service connecting employee punches, jobs, shifts and payroll calculations. Mobile and shared-kiosk entry can include identity/location checks depending on the selected configuration.

The distinction between a punch, approved timesheet and paid payroll matters. Software can calculate gross/net figures and export records without independently proving every rule, identity or payment correct.
description_zh:
Fareclock 是连接员工打卡、工作项、班次及薪资计算的考勤/劳动力管理服务。移动端和共享 kiosk 可按配置加入身份或地点检查。

打卡、已批工时表和已支付薪资必须区分。软件可以计算毛额/净额并导出，但不能独立证明所有规则、身份和付款正确。

core_features.explanation_en: Capture attendance with configured PIN, face, QR/NFC or location options.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按配置通过 PIN、人脸、二维码/NFC 或定位采集考勤。

core_features.explanation_en: Associate hours with jobs and apply pay-code/approval rules before export.
core_features.explanation_zh: 将工时关联工作项，导出前应用工资代码/审批规则。

en: Prepare employees, jobs/cost codes, devices, shift rules and pay periods. Record a representative shift with a break and a missed punch request, then compare job allocation and the approved timesheet before export. Face recognition and location stamps are vendor-described checks, not independently measured anti-fraud guarantees.
zh: 准备员工、工作项/成本代码、设备、班次规则及工资周期。记录包含休息和漏打卡申请的代表性班次，导出前核对工作分配及已批工时表。人脸和位置标记是厂商描述的检查，未独立测量防作弊保证。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: reconcile a worker’s shift and job hours
sections.title_zh: 示例：核对员工班次与工作项工时
sections.en:
Prepare employees, jobs/cost codes, devices, shift rules and pay periods. Record a representative shift with a break and a missed punch request, then compare job allocation and the approved timesheet before export. Face recognition and location stamps are vendor-described checks, not independently measured anti-fraud guarantees.

Test denied location access and a disputed correction. A failed identity check or missing device entry needs a human correction path; no attendance event was executed for this profile.
sections.zh:
准备员工、工作项/成本代码、设备、班次规则及工资周期。记录包含休息和漏打卡申请的代表性班次，导出前核对工作分配及已批工时表。人脸和位置标记是厂商描述的检查，未独立测量防作弊保证。

应测试拒绝定位权限及有争议的更正。身份检查失败或设备记录缺失需要人工更正路径；本文未实际打卡。

sections.en:
The monthly USD calculator shows Pro as $11 base plus $1.65 per user and Premium $17 base plus $2.50 per user. Its five-user examples are $19.25 and $29.50. Annual-billing figures appear separately with slightly different rounded components, so obtain the actual invoice total. Enterprise is custom.

Basic is labeled Free/up to five users but also “Free for 30 Days” beneath a full-feature trial banner. The duration of any sustained Basic entitlement is not clear enough to promise permanent free use. Premium adds live GPS, forms and net-pay-related features; verify legal/payroll jurisdiction and module scope separately.
sections.zh:
USD 月度计算器显示 Pro 基础 $11 加每用户 $1.65，Premium 基础 $17 加每用户 $2.50。五用户示例分别 $19.25 和 $29.50。年付另有略不同的取整组件，因此应获取实际发票总额。Enterprise 定制。

Basic 标为免费/最多五位，但在完整功能试用横幅下也写“免费三十天”，不够明确，不能承诺永久免费。Premium 加实时 GPS、表单及净薪相关能力，具体工资法域与模块范围需单查。

sections.title_en: Attendance platform and unverified operational claims
sections.title_zh: 考勤平台与未核实运营主张
sections.en:
Employers combining site attendance and job costing can evaluate Fareclock; a personal activity journal may not need the controls. Establish administrators, biometric/location collection policy, correction rights and export mappings before rollout. Reconcile the source timecard after a sync error before repeating a payroll import.

No mobile, kiosk, biometric, payroll calculation, API, licence, self-hosting or recovery test was performed. Compliance labels describe intended support and do not certify the buyer’s configured pay rules.
sections.zh:
需要结合现场考勤和工作成本的雇主可评估 Fareclock，个人活动日志可能无需这些控制。上线前明确管理员、生物/定位采集政策、更正权及导出映射。同步错误后，重复导入薪资前先核对来源工时卡。

未测试手机、kiosk、生物识别、工资计算、API、许可、自托管或恢复。合规标签描述支持方向，不能认证买家配置的工资规则。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Sustained Basic terms, actual invoice rounding, regional payroll, identity/location accuracy, licence and restore not verified.
research_gaps.zh: Basic 长期条件、发票取整、地区薪资、身份/定位准确性、许可及恢复未核实。
